title: doc-updater

goal.text: Keep affected existing external documentation consistent with established knowledge.

requirements.summary: Update only affected existing documents inside the frozen paths, preserving their purpose, conventions and unrelated edits.
acceptanceCriteria: Existing eligible documents reflect confirmed current facts without erasing accurately scoped requirements, history or future design.
No document is created, moved, renamed or modified outside the frozen paths.
Changed paths, supported no-edit decisions and unresolved conflicts are reported honestly.

tasks.title: Update and verify affected external documentation
tasks.detail: Use the parent assignment materials, frozen external documentation paths and resulting canonical Truth/ADR. Identify affected existing documents, inspect relevant passages, and distinguish current state from requirements, examples, history and future design. Choose the investigation and edit order that resolves the actual uncertainty. Repair supported stale claims while preserving each document’s language, structure and unrelated edits. Verify the affected passages and relevant references with proportionate checks; use semantic and exact-identifier search when each adds evidence. If nothing needs changing or a claim cannot be resolved safely, record the no-edit reason. Do not invent documents or report an unresolved material conflict as success.

rules: Modify only existing documents inside the frozen external paths; never create, move or rename documents.
Preserve local document conventions and unrelated user edits; canonical Truth/ADR formatting is not required here.
Dependent current-state writes require established evidence. Unresolved prerequisites block those writes, not inspection or honest reporting.
